{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u051/system/state/workspace/programs/task-0ffb89f9.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The background color fills the full-width separator row(s); each colored
    # horizontal run is one object. Encode object colors in descending order.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objects = Counter()
    for row in grid:
        c = 0
        while c < len(row):
            if row[c] == bg:
                c += 1
                continue
            color = row[c]
            objects[color] += 1
            while c < len(row) and row[c] == color:
                c += 1
    cells = []
    for color in sorted(objects, reverse=True):
        cells.extend([color] * objects[color])
    cells = (cells + [0] * 6)[:6]
    return [cells[:3], cells[3:]]
"
}
